title: Certified reference table for Newell demagnetization-tensor entries with two-sided rational enclosures, and a rigorous quantification of the large-separation floating-point pathology

formulas.source: A. J. Newell, W. Williams, D. J. Dunlop, J. Geophys. Res. 98(B6) 9551-9555 (1993); implemented as in OOMMF demagcoef.cc (Oxs_Newell_f, Oxs_Newell_g, Oxs_SelfDemagNx, Oxs_CalculateNxx/Nxy). Asymptotic expansion: OOMMF DemagNxxAsymptotic (Fangohr demagderiv, mu0 dropped).
formulas.tensor_def: N(r) = -(1/(4 pi |sigma|)) int_sigma1 int_sigma2 grad_r1 grad_r2 (1/|r1-r2|); Newell 1993 eq. (16): Hx = -Nxx Mx.
formulas.stencil: Nxx = (1/(4 pi dx dy dz)) * D2x D2y D2z [f]; 27-point second-difference, weights (-1) at 8 corners, (+2) at 12 edges, (-4) at 6 faces, (+8) at centre. Nxy likewise with g.

method.arithmetic: Interval arithmetic over dyadic-rational endpoints; every operation rounds OUTWARD to grid denominator D = 2**PREC; each interval rigorously encloses the true value.
method.transcendentals: sqrt via integer sqrt with two-sided rational bounds; atan by half-angle reduction to |t|<=1/2 then alternating series (first-omitted-term remainder); log by 2-power reduction to m in [2/3,4/3] then 2*atanh((m-1)/(m+1)) with geometric tail bound; pi via Machin 4 atan(1/5)-atan(1/239).
method.certified: N_lo <= N_true <= N_hi for the analytic Newell tensor entry. What is ENCLOSED: the transcendental (sqrt, atan, log) pieces, each to two-sided rational bounds. What is EXACT: the rational stencil weights, cell dims, offsets, and all rational arithmetic.

naive_semantics: naive_double = the same closed-form Newell stencil evaluated in IEEE-754 double precision with the C math library (math.sqrt/atan2/log), as a from-scratch double-precision analytic implementation would compute it. correct_digits are RIGOROUS brackets derived from the certified enclosure.
